statement: How an integration tells an agent to get the input is part of the measurement. The first Claude plugin skill told Claude to shallow-clone a remote repository before scanning it, and on lukeed/clsx that moved B2 from verified (1.7) to warning (1.6) while the certificate declared no scan limitation (#428). Neither the plugin's validation nor the suite could see it; only running the shipped prompts end to end on a real public repository surfaced it, along with an AVA false-hollow assertion (#427) in the first example repository. Rule: before an integration instructs an agent how to acquire or prepare a scan target, scan the target both ways (as instructed and complete), diff the certificates, and run every example prompt it publishes on the repository it names before publishing it.
